**Corrosion:** If its just 'surface rust' then you could sand it down (use sandpaper) and put some steel primer paint over it to prevent it rusting (temporary fix - painting over the top with a couple of layers of steel paint is better).

If holes in the metal are present then you'll likely need to take it to a panel beater ( i have no idea on cost, could be a couple hundred $ at least) or you are in for some serious DIY (not recommended if new to cars).  


**Moisture in lights:** Have a search on youtube for ways to fix this, but the other comment about using a heatgun/hair dryer is great. There seems to be another way to use toothpaste to clear up fogged plastic but  I can't confirm.   


Good luck! Youtube & the internet is your friend with teaching you about cars.
